eyebrow.zh: 按任务 · 测得清 · 看得见

headline.zh: 按任务量出编码 agent 过度思考烧掉的 token
headline.en: Measure the tokens your coding agent burns overthinking — per task

sub.zh: thinkcap 跑五项固定任务，逐类记下 Qwen3.8 每条响应烧了多少 reasoning token，写成一张按任务预算表；再以一个即插即用的代理站在编码 agent 前面，告诉你它本该在哪一类活上被收敛。
sub.en: thinkcap runs five fixed tasks, records how many reasoning tokens Qwen3.8 burns per response for each class, and writes a per-task budget table — then stands as a drop-in proxy in front of your coding agent and tells you where it would have reined each class in.

title.zh: 按任务量出烧掉的 reasoning token
title.en: Measure reasoning-token burn — per task class

body.zh: 跑五项固定任务，逐类记下每条流式响应里烧在思考上的 reasoning token，打出一张按任务类的分布表——rename 多少、refactor 多少，一目了然。
body.en: Run five fixed tasks, record how many reasoning tokens each class burns on thinking per streamed response, and print a per-task-class distribution table — how much for a rename, how much for a refactor, all in plain view.

chips: › 覆盖 rename / bugfix / refactor / new_file / default
› 服务器不支持时退化为估算，标 approx

title.zh: 一份按任务的预算，可读可改
title.en: A per-task budget you can read and edit

body.zh: 每一类活观察到的 token 分布，都被写成一条按任务的预算——预算值、来源、收敛时该注入什么，都在里面，纯文本、可 diff。
body.en: Each class's observed token distribution becomes one per-task budget entry — the budget value, its source, and what to inject when reining it in, all in one plain-text file you can diff.

chips: › 每类一条预算，按观测或手动设
› 重跑同类自动扩宽分布

title.zh: 代理站在前面，告诉你它会在哪收敛
title.en: A proxy in front that tells you where it would rein in

body.zh: 把编码 agent 的请求地址改到 :8088，thinkcap 就以一个即插即用的流式代理站在它前面——它在每一条实时思考轨迹上对照本类预算，超过时在日志里写下本该在第 N 个 token 收敛，先观察、不动手。
body.en: Repoint your coding agent to :8088 and thinkcap stands as a drop-in streaming proxy in front of it — it checks each live thinking trace against the per-class budget and, when crossed, logs that it would rein in at N tokens, observing first, never touching the stream.

chips: › v0.1 默认观察模式，绝不改流
› 一个 curl 看连接、生效类、是否在收敛

body.zh: 用内置的预设响应跑完整流水线，不需要活的推理服务——先看机制、再对着你本地的 Qwen3.8 跑真实数字。
body.en: Run the full pipeline against built-in preset responses — no live inference server needed — see the mechanism first, then run real numbers against your own local Qwen3.8.

chips: › 真实前后对比对着你自己的服务器跑

tag.zh: 按任务量出 Qwen3.8 编码 agent 烧掉的 reasoning token——MIT，开源。
tag.en: Per-task measurement of your Qwen3.8 coding agent's reasoning tokens — MIT, open source.
